description: A twist of oily grey powder that smells faintly of hot metal and hospital corridors. They say it introduces you to people.

phantoms.arrive: A gaunt man in a hospital gown shuffles in from the edge of the room and stops against the wall, watching you.
barks: The gaunt man's lips move, but no sound comes out.
The gaunt man takes one slow step closer, still watching.
The gaunt man tilts his head, studying you like a puzzle.
phantoms.depart: You glance away for a second, and when you look back the gaunt man is simply gone.
phantoms.look: He stands too still, gown stained grey at the hem. When you meet his eyes he does not blink, and his smile does not reach them.
phantoms.name: a gaunt man in a hospital gown
phantoms.talk: The gaunt man doesn't answer. He only watches, and smiles a little.

phantoms.arrive: A low black dog pads out from behind you, hackles up, and fixes on you with wet yellow eyes.
barks: The black dog growls, a sound you feel in your teeth.
The black dog circles you, never breaking its stare.
phantoms.depart: The black dog slinks into a shadow too shallow to hold it, and is gone.
phantoms.look: Its ribs show through matted fur and its jaw hangs slightly wrong. It watches you the way a thing watches food.
phantoms.name: a low black dog

phantoms.arrive: A tall figure in a wide-brimmed hat is suddenly in the corner, as if it had always been there. You just hadn't noticed.
barks: The tall figure hasn't moved. You're fairly sure it hasn't moved.
For a moment the tall figure's hat brim lifts, and there is nothing beneath it.
phantoms.depart: The corner is just a corner again. It always was.
phantoms.look: You can't quite make out its face under that brim, no matter how hard you try. The harder you try, the less there seems to be.
phantoms.name: a tall figure in a wide-brimmed hat
phantoms.talk: The figure under the hat says nothing. The brim tips, very slightly, toward you.

phases.comedown_message: The air thins out. You're alone again — you think.
phases.comeup_message: The room goes very quiet, and its corners feel closer than they were.

name: Wraithdust
